title: Housing Crash Risk: What Prices and Mortgage Rates Show
description:
Jeremiah Babe’s housing crash forecast is a warning, not a guaranteed outcome. This breakdown follows his inflation outlook and call for aggressive Fed hikes, bullish gold and silver view, Iran-related oil concerns, bearish 2027 stock outlook, and warnings about housing and adjustable-rate mortgages. We distinguish those predictions from the supplied inflation, mortgage-rate and housing figures, then address reported Kroger layoff plans without treating them as confirmed job losses. The practical takeaway: financial anxiety is understandable, but panic is not a plan. Stress-test your payments and preserve a cash cushion.

For entertainment and informational purposes only. This is not financial, legal, medical, or other professional advice. Consult a qualified professional about your circumstances. We are not responsible for decisions or results based on this video.

#Jeremiahbabe #Jeremiahbabehousingcrash #housingmarketcrashforecast #MentalHealth #Wellness
